title: A slice of a cycle is the boundary of the corresponding restriction
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with ∂T = 0, f : ℝ^P → ℝ, t ∈ ℝ, and S ∈ D_m(U) with IsSlice T f t S (S = ∂(T ⌞ {f < t}) − (∂T) ⌞ {f < t}, with the sets taken inside U). Then there is A ∈ D_{m+1}(U) such that A is a restriction of T to {x ∈ U : f(x) < t} (IsRestriction T {x ∈ U : f(x) < t} A) and ∂A = S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsOpen U → T.boundary = 0 → IsSlice T f t S → ∃ A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsRestriction T {x | x ∈ U ∧ f x < t} A ∧ A.boundary = S
